KIRBY_MOD_RELIC_COPY_ABILITY.title: Copy Ability
KIRBY_MOD_RELIC_COPY_ABILITY.description: Whenever a single attack makes you lose {HpLoss} or more HP while you have a Copy Ability, lose it ([gold]Exhaust[/gold] all cards it gave you) and return [gold]Inhale[/gold] from your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
KIRBY_MOD_RELIC_ABILITY_PROTECTOR.title: Ability Protector
KIRBY_MOD_RELIC_ABILITY_PROTECTOR.descri: At the start of combat, gain {AbilityConservationPower} [gold]Ability Conservation[/gold].
KIRBY_MOD_RELIC_FRIENDSHIP_STAR.title: Friendship Star
KIRBY_MOD_RELIC_FRIENDSHIP_STAR.descript: At the end of your turn, if you dealt no damage this turn, apply {WeakPower} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
KIRBY_MOD_RELIC_BOSS_PREP.title: Boss Prep
KIRBY_MOD_RELIC_BOSS_PREP.description: At the start of combat, choose 1 of {Cards} Copy Ability cards to put into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It costs 0 this turn.
KIRBY_MOD_RELIC_COPY_ESSENCE_DELUXE.desc: Whenever a single attack makes you lose {HpLoss} or more HP while you have a Copy Ability, lose it ([gold]Exhaust[/gold] all cards it gave you) and return [gold]Inhale[/gold] from your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
